# Platform

## Capabilities

### [Installation System](./installation-system.md)
**Status:** active | **ACs:** 4/4 (all met)

The install.sh script provides multi-mode installation of genie-team artifacts into Claude Code's .claude/ directory structure with worktree detection, MCP setup, and component-level selective installation.

### [Session State Tracking](./session-state-tracking.md)
**Status:** active | **ACs:** 4/4 (all met)

Three event hooks maintain session state across context compactions without any LLM cost, capturing command invocations, tracking artifact files, and re-injecting context after compaction.

### [Environment Health](./environment-health.md)
**Status:** active | **ACs:** 0/7 (pending — superseded by SDK Orchestrator AC-2, AC-6, AC-7)

Runtime environment validation, authentication control, and model tier configuration. Provides post-install health checks, `genies check` diagnostics, auth mode control for billing path selection, and per-genie model routing via `genie-config.yaml`.

### [SDK-Integrated Orchestrator](./sdk-orchestrator.md)
**Status:** active | **ACs:** 0/9 (pending — designed, ready for delivery)

TypeScript orchestration layer using the Claude Agent SDK. Replaces shell-based CLI spawning with programmatic execution governance (hooks, budget caps, structured output), typed parsing, async parallel execution, and session continuity across genie phases. Subsumes Environment Health features. Design constraints established; ADR-005 accepted.
